## Summary

Describe the research/software problem and the change.

## Validation

- [ ] Relevant tests were added or updated when behavior changed.
- [ ] `python -m pytest -q` passes locally.
- [ ] `python -m ruff check app.py src tests` passes locally.
- [ ] Documentation was updated when user-facing behavior changed.
- [ ] No confidential or restricted research data are included.

## Methodological impact

Explain any change to data interpretation, statistical assumptions, missing-data handling, or report wording. Write `None` if the change has no methodological impact.
